headline: A compact command center for the Royals season

latest_prospect_update.name: Blake Mitchell
latest_prospect_update.note: Most obvious remaining minor-league prospect to track; catcher development and power/patience are the main signals. Recent line: .261 / .400 / .391.

nightly_recap: The Royals beat the Boston Red Sox, KC 3, BOS 2. Seth Lugo led the night, working 5.0 innings with 2 earned runs, 7 strikeouts and 2 walks. Carter Jensen supplied the loudest Royals contact at 110.0 mph.
